_comment: READY-NOW-REMOVE-1. The scan no longer gives the result ReadyNow (Already on a target size,
Already migrated). Since 2026-11-06, a machine whose size is not in the Current lifecycle
stage is assessed like any other machine - Can migrate when a target exists, else Cannot yet
with its reason. After ALREADY-CURRENT-1 the only machines that still read ReadyNow were the
v5 sizes with NVMe, Ebsv5 and Ebdsv5, and Microsoft lists Ebsv6 as their successor.
os, sourceSize, diskController: the machine as the scan reads it. stage: the lifecycle stage
the data gives for sourceSize (null: the data has none). stored: the classification an older
assessment holds (null: the scan of this build writes the record). scan: what this build's
scan writes. readAs: the classification the plan reads for v6 (Resolve-VmfEntryClassification).
nvmePrep: the NVMe preparation codes the scan writes - a machine already on NVMe gets them
too (review round 1: the scripts are idempotent, and the guard before the stop reads them). group: the group every page shows (VmfReport.machineGroup).
openV6, openV7: whether the plan finds a path to that series (Get-VmfPathSelection is not
EXCLUDED). targetDiskArch: the kind of temporary disk of the v6 size the plan gives.

cases.name: Windows on Ebsv5 with NVMe: can migrate, to Ebsv6
Linux on Ebdsv5 with NVMe: can migrate, to Ebdsv6
Windows on Ebdsv5 with NVMe: can migrate, to Ebdsv6
Windows on Ebsv5 with SCSI: as before
Linux on Ebsv5 with SCSI: as before
Windows on D2ds_v6 with NVMe: Current, and no move to v6 or v7
a size the lifecycle data does not hold, on NVMe: no move to v6 or v7, as unknown is not a yes
